name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Bauer, Botanist, Beacon, and Venus belong to different colonists.
Geode goes with at least one of Captain or Lumen.
Echo goes with either Medic or Callisto (but not both).
Botanist goes with neither Earth nor Algae.
Earth goes with exactly two of Cho, Technician, Beacon, and Algae.
Cortex goes with at least one of Anders, Captain, or Callisto.
Bauer goes with exactly three of Technician, Lumen, Callisto, and Algae.
Bauer goes with at least one of Botanist, Venus, or Regolith.
